old: - `mcdp1-warfighting-retro.md` — US Marine Corps MCDP-1 (1997). Public domain (US Government work product); scope=open. Doctrinal philosophy for teams operating in high-tempo / high-uncertainty / decentralised-execution contexts (SRE, startup, incident response, agile teams under heavy delivery pressure). Six retro threads: (1) *doctrine is a way of thinking, not a checklist* (Ch 3) — for teams treating runbooks / playbooks / standards as scripts; (2) *Schwerpunkt / main effort* (Ch 4) — *what is our main effort right now; could every team member state it in one sentence; would they agree?*; (3) *commander's intent must be understood two levels up* (Ch 4) — when the team doesn't know it, the leadership communication is the upstream cause; (4) OODA loop (Ch 2 Notes 18, credited to Boyd) — *what is our team's OODA tempo relative to the market / customer's; where is the Orient bottleneck?*; (5) *attrition vs maneuver* (Ch 2) — diagnose which mode the team is in and whether the situation rewards it; (6) *leniency on overbold errors, severity on errors of inaction* (Ch 3) — fear-of-mistakes cultures produce inaction.
new: - `mcdp1-warfighting-retro.md` — U.S. Marine Corps, *MCDP 1: Warfighting* (1997). Public domain (US Government work); scope=open. Not a retrospective method: it gives the lead a stance, and the mechanics come from the method sources. Ch 3 critique discipline (review even after success and promptly, all hands encouraged to contribute, candour depends on the tolerance of whoever holds authority, focus on why actions were taken); Ch 3 error climate (no "zero defects" mentality, leniency for errors of boldness, severity for errors of inaction carried into the retro as a topic rather than a sanction, honest dissent before a decision and support after it); Ch 4 main effort and commander's intent for experiment design; Ch 1 self-induced friction as a delta-sorting prompt. Principal applicability: Phase 0, 0.5, 2, 3, 4.
why: Replaces the old description, which carried findings from the 2026-09-27 audit (Schwerpunkt, 'never how', 'two levels up' hardened, senior-only burden, OODA/Orient via a source not in the corpus, 'errors of commission'), and describes the regenerated distillation's content.
